fact: A ministerial order of 27 December 2024 sets a migration calendar obliging certain contracting bodies to pass all their contracts exclusively through COLEPS; by January 2025, 8143 contracts worth 1745 billion F had been programmed and published on COLEPS for 2025, against 7372 in 2024.
title: Passation en ligne des marchés publics : les maîtres d'ouvrages appelés à se conformer
